notes.title: Patch Notes V0.3.4.2
notes.content:
Changes

 Added call to action after player returns from session
 Added light indicators for when altars are ready 

			
Bug Fixes

 Fixed the leaderboard order and redesigned the information for songs and made it update correctly when changing difficulty
 Fixed an animation bug with the hands when gripping
 When grabbing for new magic during the session it should now always collect magic and not be blocked
 Song and difficulty globes will no longer activate the altars when a tutorial is selected for the map (because it doesn't require song or difficulty)

			
Polish

 Added nicer text animations

notes.title: Patch notes V0.3.4.1
notes.content:
Changes
			
			 Added support for custom voice lines depending on steamID
			 Shooters life has been halved
			 Ultimates trigger now with less movement downwards
			
			
			Bug Fixes
			
			 Fixed a bug where projectiles would always have full charge (full damage), they will now have damage & aoe radius according to their real charge level
			 Customizations like hands are now correctly saved and persisted 
			 Minor bug fixes
			
			
			Polish
			
			 Polished the entry level
			 Not hiding the song menu anymore

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.3.4.0
notes.content:
Features
		
		 INTRODUCING, Drog and Bog. They will have cute little dialogues (around 30 different ones as of now) and might even give you some tips here and there in the future.
		 Overhaul of the main menu layout. 
		
		 There is more space to the portal. 
		 Replaced the frame around the portal with Drog and Bog.
		 Renamed settings and customizations menus to have shorter names.
		 Placed the menus more around the player to not hide Drog and Bog behind the menu infos.
		
		 Ultimates are easier to trigger now! Simply move your hand which is ready to cast an ultimate (indicated by the particles around the mana gauges) down quickly instead of in a throwing motion while opening it.
		 Removed normal difficulty added hard, to raise expectations for the shooters. 
		 Added a warning from the companions when a shooter is spawning.
		 Reduced the volume of main menu music and it will be quieter when the trees are talking.
		
		
		Bug Fixes
		
		 Fixed that leaderboards wouldn't add new entries!
		 Fixed indicator hands on globe menus still appearing when it is closed
		 Several other bugs
		
		
		Polish
		
		 The portal has nicer particles now.

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.3.3.0
notes.content:
Features

 Each song now has 2 difficulties, Easy and Normal!
 On normal difficulties there will be shooters spawning now, beware!
 The player can take 3 hits from shooters (vision will be gradually impaired). Any further damage will force you to retreat and forfeit the battle!
 The altar in the main menu was adjusted to accompany the choice of difficulty and give some space for future companions (subtle teaser for the next patch)!
 The globes in the main menu now use the same physics based acceleration as the projectiles in the levels. This is a bit weird when moving quickly to a location and letting the object go abruptly to place is, but is much more fun for throwing around the globes into the forest!


Bug Fixes

 The randomization script for the enemy spawns will now ensure much better results!


Polish

 The menu handling has been improved and should be much less annoying now!
 Unavailable choices for songs, maps and difficulties have been removed for clearity!

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.3.2.0
notes.content:
Features

 Reworked the throwing mechanic! It should feel much better now and be more accurate!
 Integrated an aim assist system where projectiles are slightly nudged towards enemies who are close to their impact point.
 Reworked particle spawns. They will spawn further away giving more time to react and also take a consistent time to reach the player depending on the difficulty setting. 
 Integrated the first progression step. The bandaged hand model will now only be available after unlocking the "Disciple of the Realm" achievement. (known bug: it will be lost upon restart though :D)


Bug Fixes

 Reworked save game for replays. Should not junk your local save game folder anymore.
 Couple of other bug fixes here and there.


Polish

 The menu navigation should also feel better now. Menus are morphing back to the glass globes with a delay and the snapping of globes to their rest positions should work much better.

notes.title: Patch notes V0.3.1.1
notes.content:
Features

 added indicators to guide main menu navigation
 Implemented a replay manager for player behavior analysis, save games will be stored in the local directory that can be send in for analysis
 Implemented height adjustment in the main menu to accommodate different player sizes
 Improved throwing (late releases of projectiles should lead much more rarely to unexpected trajectories)


Bugfixes

 Fixed issues with save game to correctly restore the state after reentering the main menu
 Fixed getting stuck in tutorial at some occasions
 Fixed text on level stone 


Polish

 Increased AOE radii of fire and lightning spells slightly
 Removed placeholder items for campaign and additional album to reduce confusion
 Reworked the menu info for maps to show a mirage of the map and 3D model of enemies. This also fixes an issue where resetting the view in some headsets would cause a desyncing of the renderings for each eye in VR.
 Reduced the delay for picking items from the menu
